node.statement: After first choosing a universal c0 witness for which lem-maincb-error-improvement remains valid, fixing the corresponding L^0,e_env^0 witnesses of lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope, and fixing the C_s2^0,e_s2^0 witnesses of lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum, there is a universal K_2^0 >= 1 with every Stage-2 prerequisite absorbed such that for every def-maincb-witness-ledger datum W with W.c0_cb = c0, W.L >= L^0, W.K2 >= max{K_2^0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L}, and W.e_s2 <= e_s2^0, if A is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra, w:C^m->A is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion satisfying ||w(I_{C^m})-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon with one-dimensional atomic images, a supplied MAIN partition state for A,w has nonempty U contained in one equivalence class, j notin U in that same class, and R=U union {j}, 0 <= epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, and a supplied current reset isomorphism v_U:M_{|U|}->A_U satisfies d_U <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U and ||v_U(I_{M_{|U|}})-u_{A_U}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U, then epsilon_U,epsilon_R <= W.L*epsilon and t_2=W.K2*epsilon dominates all datum errors, so lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum furnishes the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum with total defect at most C_s2^0*t_2.
